title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
one_line_judgement: 今天值得试：据摘要（arXiv 2610.13928）：AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabiliti…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.13928）：AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities 把 capability evaluation 的'假设 hidden capability 能 elicit + evaluations 能 surface dangerous behaviors'拉到'backdoor attacks：embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights，decrypt+execute only upon secret trigger；digital lockers 使 hidden circuits provably hard to elicit and interpret'。是 security-governance × llm-evaluation × ai-agent 的 provably-hard-to-elicit hidden capability 即时资产——'capability-hiding-as-evaluation-attack' 范式可迁移到任何 'capability evaluation governance / model deployment safety / agent oversight' 子方向（frontier model red-team / agent red-team / safety case building），与 aiutil 长期关注的 security-governance × llm-evaluation 主线在 'evaluation reliability under adversarial' 层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 digital locker 形式化、加密 circuit 与 trigger 形式化、跨 trigger 条件验证、'provably hard to elicit/interpret' 的形式化证明、是否开源 attack pipeline 与 evaluation harness。
